text:
maria: FYI ConcordBank sent a short but specific security questionnaire for our private deployment. They want: RBAC change log (last 90d), audit samples for key unwraps, HSM attestation summary, CVE status for three deps, and an IR excerpt for key compromise. starting this thread to coordinate artifacts.

dan: can you paste the drive link?

maria: https://drive.internal/concordbank-q2. They explicitly say representative samples only.

owen: plan: assemble a compact evidence bundle with: signed-manifest.txt, redacted-audit-unwraps.gz, rbac-90d.csv (emails -> REDACTED), hsm-attest-summary.pdf, vuln-status.txt. No raw key material.

claire: vuln-triage: sec-bot reports CVE-2026-2101 (protobuf) patched in 3.4.2; CVE-2025-9888 (jsonlib) backported fix in 1.5.1; both hosted/dedicated patched. onprem needs scheduled maintenance. recommend including mitigation notes (WAF + restrict management ports).

sec-bot: vuln-triage: CVE-2026-2101 fixed in protobuf 3.4.2. CVE-2025-9888 fixed in jsonlib 1.5.1. Severity: medium/low.

maria: @owen please run RBAC export helper with 90d window and redact emails:
```
./bin/export_rbac --days=90 --redact=emails --out=rbac-concord-90d.csv
```
Include approver and ticket id fields.

owen: exporting now. note: change history includes automated role grants from onboarding pipeline; will mark those in the manifest.

dan: for audit samples, filter for event types unwrap, decrypt, key_rotate. Use this script:
```
./tools/audit_query --from=2026-01-01 --to=2026-03-31 --events unwrap,decrypt,key_rotate --redact tenant,email > redacted-audit-concord.gz
```

owen: uploaded initial bundle to /evidence/concord/2026-04-05 (zipped + cosign). manifest includes sha256s and redaction notes.

maria: IR playbook excerpt to include: detection -> preserve -> isolate -> rotate -> validate -> notify. Add times where possible: notify customer within 2 hours of confirmed compromise.

claire: add a short SIEM correlation snippet linking unwrap -> admin-login -> suspicious egress. Keep identifiers synthetic.

dan: legal check: we need to confirm consent before sharing any HSM challenge/attestation logs that contain customer key IDs. I'll loop in legal for a short consent note.

maria: agreed. provide attestation summary without key IDs if legal requests that. include signer CN and timestamp.

sec-bot: note: dependent-package advisory for depX low-severity. ticket INFSEC-5102 created and scheduled for 04/12. add reference in vuln-status.txt.

maria: thanks team. call scheduled to walk through the bundle 09:30am PT tomorrow — need tech + security leads. @dan can you do tech?

dan: yep.

maria: @claire sec lead?

claire: yes.

maria: I'll draft answers and attach the bundle after legal ack. tagging this thread ready-for-review. :white_check_mark:

owen: one small follow-up  customer asked for RBAC approval proof for one change. I'll pull the ticket reference TKT-1147 and redact personal data, include the ticket link in manifest.

dan: perfect, add that as an example line in rbac-90d.csv.

maria: closing unless legal or customer asks for more.
